options.name: Calm Editorial
options.direction: Warm, light editorial portfolio with restrained technical details.
options.layout: Asymmetric editorial hero, proof strip, large project case studies, compact experience timeline, grouped capabilities, education and contact.
options.motion: Soft section reveals, small image parallax and hover lift; optional lazy hero-only Three.js living contour with a static fallback.
options.tradeoffs: Best readability and recruiter scan speed; the memorable effect comes from typography, composition and one restrained 3D moment rather than a dark immersive theme.

options.name: Graphite Studio
options.direction: Dark neutral engineering studio with muted teal and amber accents.
options.layout: Modular grid hero, compact engineering metrics, visual case-study cards, timeline, capability matrix and contact panel.
options.motion: Sharper panel transitions and a hero-only Three.js node field rendered on demand with reduced-motion fallback.
options.tradeoffs: More cinematic and technical, but closer to the dark mood of the current site and slightly less aligned with the request to make the page feel lighter and calmer.
